answer_1.quote: Built upon these meme images, our dataset comprises specific, realistic harmful tasks that can pose genuine societal problems, including the generation of sexual narratives, fake news, and scam emails.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include responses to harmful and harmless instructions such as fabricated news articles, scam emails, toxic comments, story generation, and manual/guideline writing, based on meme-image prompts.

answer_4.quote: To validate the quality of the generated instructions, we conduct a human evaluation on an equal-allocation stratified sample of the dataset (total n=390; 13 per task across 30 tasks), designed to achieve a 95% confidence level.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to assess whether the instruction faithfully captures the intent of its associated task definition, using predefined criteria for instruction quality.
criteria: logical alignment with category and task
